summary: Add opt-in exact-tree signed evidence reuse for merge groups, disabled until post-merge hosted proof is available

schema.detail: Signed record formats and bindings are unchanged.

rules.detail: Runtime authority is unchanged. CI reads the merge_group mode and verification policy only from BASE; queue reuse requires full-tier exact-tree evidence and existing key, principal, command, input and lane checks.

compatibility.detail: Absent, invalid or off merge_group mode runs hosted CI. Pull-request evidence and refusal behavior are unchanged.

manual.detail: The mode remains off. Activation requires a separate policy change after conditional post-merge hosted proof is deployed.

recovery.detail: Set merge_group to off at the accepted base to retain hosted queue checks.
